comments.content: The OpenAPI tag is named `Workflow`, and URL fragments are case-sensitive. Lowercasing this to `#tag/workflow` breaks the endpoint deep link. Please preserve `#tag/Workflow`; the update-operation link below needs the same correction.

`Debug` starts a new sentence here, so lowercasing it introduces a user-visible grammar error. Please keep it capitalized and revisit the equivalent bulk changes that produce sentence starts such as `. we`, `. choose`, and `. use`.
